title: Compositional Fusion of Signals in Data Embedding

bias_targets.methodology: Using Correlation-based Fusion Detection (Canonical Correlation Analysis) and Additive Fusion Detection (linear decomposition via the pseudo-inverse method) to measure the extent to which behavior-based user embeddings implicitly capture gender signals.
